results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Protests to greet Trump in Manila over Pax Silica
results.content: The protesters are opposing the US-led initiative that seeks to secure supply chains for critical minerals and semiconductors through partnerships with other countries
